name: trevorhecht-skills
description: Claude Code skills and commands by Trevor Hecht. Opinionated workflow automation for Next.js, Prisma, and macOS.

plugins.name: global
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic workflow: trevskills-autopilot (end-to-end builds), backlog (capture ideas), trevskills-todo-report (ranked TODO scan), plus the /trevskills-commitpush and /trevskills-migrate safety commands.

plugins.name: nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js work: trevskills-nextjs-ui (shadcn/Tailwind component, layout, and mobile rules) and trevskills-twilio-email-setup (Twilio email/SMS wiring and 400-error debugging).

plugins.name: macos
plugins.description: macOS utilities: trevskills-mac-cleanup (disk space, System Data, runaway processes, adware checks) and trevskills-timecard (log work shifts to Apple Calendar).
